keywords: Verification process 2.Problem-solving process 3.Basic skills 4.Data handling skills 5.PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: -To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions. -To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively. -To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events. -To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities. -To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice: In this course, we will take up the characteristic objects and phenomena of the department to which each student belongs, and learn the basic skills required for the verification process and problem-solving process. Through experimental activities, learn the basics of "data handling skills" required to collect data → organize → analyze → hypothesis → visualization → report. In addition, students will learn the basic skills of "PBL for science and technology", including the process from problem finding to solution and the basic elements of verification activities. In the first half of "Data Handling Skills", students will conduct research, including interviews and fieldwork, on revitalizing local governments. The results will be summarized in a poster and presented. In the second half of "PBL for science and technology" basic skill learning, students will plan and create initiatives to raise awareness of the appeal and challenges of their local government, and by repeatedly improving their plans, they will gain a real feel for the PDCA cycle. Finally, students will hold a final presentation.
requiredKnowledge: No textbook is specified, but necessary pre-survey and post-review are required for each lesson. In addition, since group activities outside of class hours are essential, each student is required to actively participate in group activities.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objects, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.

To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) To be able to proceed with activities from problem-finding to solution. 2) To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events. 3) To be able to recognize characteristics and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events. 4) To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly. 5) To be able to smoothly conduct verification activities independently. 6) To be able to recognize the identity of the major (department) and be proud.
achievementLevels.standard: 1) To be able to proceed with activities from problem-finding to solution with guidance by instructor. 2) To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events with guidance. 3) To be able to recognize characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, and events with guidance. 4) To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person. 5) To be able to conduct verification activities with guidance. 6) To be able to recognize the identity of the major (department) and be proud with guidance.

lessons.assignments: Preparation of website for project design

lessons.content: ・Explanation from local government officials ・Investigation of local revitalization initiatives
・Investigation of local revitalization initiatives(ongoing) ・Developing a plan for interviews with local stakeholders
lessons.assignments: Compiling the plan for interviews with local stakeholders

lessons.content: ・Conduct interviews with local stakeholders ・Compile interview results (compile them into Word files, etc.)
・Clarify the results and challenges of current regional revitalization efforts ・Prepare poster materials (consider creating tables and graphs using Excel, etc.)
・Creating a poster in PowerPoint ・Points to note when creating a poster
lessons.assignments: Completion of poster and preparation for presentation

lessons.content: ・Identifying local issues to address ・Researching best practices in regional revitalization ・Generating ideas for new regional revitalization initiatives
・Preparing for field survey ・Preparing survey and question items

・Preparation for testing ideas for regional revitalization initiatives - Selection of evaluation indicators for the feasibility and effectiveness (expected effects) of the ideas - Confirmation of calculation methods using the evaluation indicators - Self-evaluation of initial ideas

・Verifying ideas for regional revitalization in itiatives -Conduct interviews with stakeholders and fieldw ork to verify as objectively as possible. ・Reconsider ideas for regional revitalization initiatives ・Improve ideas

・Verification activities for ideas (improvements) for regional revitalization initiatives - Conduct interviews with stakeholders and field work to verify as objectively as possible - Calculate feasibility and effectiveness using indicators

・Preparing presentation materials (using Microsoft PowerPoint) - Presentation materials should include the following: the problem to be solved, the goals to be achieved, a summary of the research activities and their results, and the proposal and its expected effects.

lessons.assignments: Review of the presentation, preparation for PDI
